caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain, light beige background. On the left side is a vertical cylindrical object resembling a barometer, colored in shades of brown, with a glass or transparent top section displaying a white scale and black text. The scale inside the cylinder has labeled divisions with numbers and descriptive words aligned in a single column, including “Very Dry,” “Set Fair,” “FAIR,” “Change,” “RAIN,” “Much Rain,” and “STORMY,” with numerical values ranging from 27 to 31. The cylinder has decorative, rounded top and bottom ends. To the right of the cylinder is a larger, rectangular white scale shown in detail, labeled "Ge Tagliatue" at the top. The scale repeats the same descriptive terms and numbers as on the cylinder, with additional labels “NEW” at the bottom left and “YORK” at the bottom right. There are two small brown dots at the top and bottom of the scale, indicating attachment points. Both objects are drawn with clear attention to linear perspective and realistic shading. The artist’s signature, “Alois E. Ulrich,” is written in the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Shaker Barometer
